correctness.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration yields 144 nonempty faces and exact f-vector (16,64,64) for each named graph. The 63 distinct incident toggle pairs per graph are checked in a complete 320-arrow directed Hasse graph whose 144 vertices topologically sort, certifying a Forman acyclic matching with critical vector (1,1,16). The original integral signed 49-by-64 triangle relation matrix, modulo a spanning tree, reduces via 48 unimodular unit row/column operations to zero; thus H1 is infinite cyclic. Since the Morse one-skeleton is S1, all 16 attaching maps have degree zero and are nullhomotopic. The homotopy type follows, not just finite-field homology.

value.rationale: The two graphs are natural, explicitly tabulated 1-well-covered but non-Cohen–Macaulay Buchsbaum circulants in a focused 2015 classification study. Their exact integral homotopy types, including the circle and sixteen essential two-spheres, are not supplied by that study. Nonisomorphic regular graphs share this nontrivial mixed-dimensional homotopy type; the complete homotopy determination is a structural refinement rather than merely a face-count or homology recomputation.
